author: SlimAssiliX
text: GPT-6 Cyber reportedly reproduced 1,724 Linux kernel vulnerabilities, built working exploits for 948 and found 81 unknown high-severity Firefox flaws, per OpenAI. Discovery and exploit validation are getting automated.

author: Rachidmarcil
text: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Cyber — its model rated 'Critical' for cyber readiness. 48.5% on ExploitGym; credited with 81 high-severity Firefox bugs and a critical Brotli flaw (CVE-2026-111497). Access restricted to vetted red teams.

author: Joshua_WD
text: Microsoft watched an AI agent go from a leaked GitHub secret to Azure Key Vault data in five minutes. The tool, ARTEX, now shows up in several campaigns, using old holes at machine speed.

author: ZetsubosenseiG
text: An AI agent built to find security flaws ended up at the center of a real data breach at WorkOS; the researcher was benchmarking ARTEX, an autonomous AI pentesting tool. WorkOS said the researcher never intended to target the company.

author: ProferoSec
text: Trojanized ARTEX images on Docker Hub (tomicdd/artex and congdonglinux/artex) gave attackers a root shell, with 7,946 pulls before disclosure. Docker removed them on Nov 5, but installed or cached copies may still be malicious.

author: tchsignal
text: Hundreds of publicly accessible ARTEX AI hacking systems have been found online. Tools designed to find vulnerabilities can become security risks themselves when left exposed.

author: stretchcloud
text: Anthropic's explanation for 1,122 public GitHub repos leaking passwords through Claude Code doesn't hold up once you check your own laptop. The company says .claude/settings.local.json is gitignored automatically, so anything that leaked must have been manually created.

author: gmrgolu
text: Apiiro found 1,122 public GitHub repos with Claude Code's settings.local.json leaking secrets, including 379 database passwords and 23 AWS keys. Cause: "Yes, don't ask again" saves full commands in plain text. Rotate keys and gitignore the file.

author: thesecguyhq
text: Prompt injection made Copilot switch on auto-approve in .vscode/settings.json (CVE-2025-53773). Gate coding-agent edits to approval config.

author: OutworkVentures
text: ChatGPT Lockdown Mode bypass: an HTML preview could exfiltrate chat data without a click in the desktop app; OpenAI patched before publication.

author: webtkdev
text: A prompt-injection filter is not a security boundary. Junie GitHub Action before 1.6.4: HTML-encoded text slipped past its filter (CVE, Nov 6). If your CI agent reads issues or PRs: pin a fixed version, read-only token, no secrets on issue triggers.

author: SiuHarry202601
text: Ask a coding agent to connect GitHub and it may install a server nobody maintains. Glow Labs found agents picking archived MCP servers from training data — four high-severity flaws, one RCE via prompt injection, no patch coming.

author: theadvtech
text: Docker Sandboxes flaw (CVE-2026-103916, CVSS 8.2) let an AI agent escape its sandbox via a symlink in the sbx cp copy command. Docker's first fix in v0.48.0 was incomplete; the final fix shipped Nov 3 in v0.51.0. Source: Endor Labs.

author: TheHackerWire
text: Critical AI Agent RCE in OpenHuman (CVE-2026-54143, CVSS 9.8): external channel messages cause the agent to create persistent shell cron jobs without human approval for host RCE. Upgrade to 0.57.13.

author: ZeroPathLabs
text: MLflow CVE-2026-118628: unauthenticated attackers can exploit get-artifacts to trigger SSRF. A proof of concept is available.

author: pwnwatch_app
text: Control Web Panel before 1.29 has an unauthenticated-to-root RCE chain: CVE-2026-73695, CVE-2026-73696, CVE-2026-73697, CVE-2026-77876 through CVE-2026-77881, and CVE-2026-104080. The issues are patched in 1.29.

author: zoomeyebot
text: Axios npm package CVE-2026-42037 allows multipart header injection through Blob.type.

author: ZeroPathLabs
text: Oracle Identity Manager CVE-2026-35265: a missing authentication flaw lets attackers fully take over Oracle Identity Manager.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: CVE-2026-55194 (CVSS 9.8): FreeRDP before 3.27.0 has a heap buffer overflow via a malicious TS Gateway that can lead to remote code execution. Patch to 3.27.0.

author: CatchyLabs
text: One detail from the Oct 21 Node.js advisory: CVE-2026-111497 is a Brotli decoder out-of-bounds write rated High. It can lead to remote code execution when an app decompresses attacker-controlled data with node:zlib.

author: AlMazajeyah
text: Actively exploited: Windows Cloud Files driver privilege escalation (CVE-2025-62221).

author: aleksandar_g_82
text: The fix for CVE-2026-83844, a Paint remote code execution flaw (CVSS 8.1), ships only via the Microsoft Store, not Windows Update. Fixed build is 11.2609.401.0. Paint installs per user, so check every copy. No known exploitation yet.

author: infrasecserv
text: CISA added CVE-2024-27834, an Apple pointer authentication bypass fixed in May 2024, to KEV after Sekoia tied it to APT29 watering-hole attacks on mobile devices. Federal deadline: Nov 18.

author: yogsec
text: CVE-2026-119977 WordPress Core TOCTOU race condition. Unauthenticated RCE during full core upgrades via predictable, web-accessible staging paths. Actively exploited; CISA added to KEV on November 3, 2026. CVSS 8.1 High.

author: YourAnon_irc
text: New active exploits: WordPress RCE (CVE-2026-119977) and Cisco/PHP2Shell flaws (CVE-2026-76461, 109618/19) threaten network and data integrity.

author: WilliamSantiago
text: CVE-2026-99270: Linux kernel TCP use-after-free (CVSS 8.1, High) in reqsk_timer_handler(). It affects kernels from 4.2 up to 7.1, so current Debian stable and Ubuntu 26.04 LTS are both affected.

author: mehvetero
text: CVE-2026-98432 is a critical Linux kernel bug (CVSS 9.8). Someone on the internet can send crafted TCP packets and take over a machine with no login needed. Ubuntu and Red Hat have not shipped a fixed kernel yet.

author: DIYprojects55
text: Google patched a critical Android zero-click flaw, CVE-2026-58868, in the November 2026 update. It is a heap buffer overflow in the Framework component that could allow remote code execution with no user interaction on Android 14-17.

author: Priosweep
text: Adobe Commerce/Magento CVE-2026-48356 (unrestricted file upload, CVSS 9.6) has been on CISA KEV since Oct 27. Federal due date is Tuesday, Nov 10. Fix is in Adobe APSB26-73.

author: suruurism
text: The Linux kernel CNA assigned 9 sequential CVEs (CVE-2026-99272 through CVE-2026-99280) for issues in the SMB stack (ksmbd + cifs). Together with CVE-2026-80724 and critical CVE-2026-80926, the total is now 11, all reported and fixed upstream.

author: fc_vulns
text: CVE-2026-59310: EPSS jumped 59.1 points (2.6 to 61.7). A malicious actor with network access to vCenter may exploit this issue to execute arbitrary code.

author: TraffAlex
text: Canonical has shipped fixes for CVE-2026-109518, a high-severity vulnerability in APT, the package manager used by Debian, Ubuntu and derivatives.

author: Pelin19si
text: Bitwarden CLI was compromised in a supply chain attack: @bitwarden/cli@2026.4.0 included malicious code after attackers hijacked GitHub Actions, stole secrets and pushed a tampered version to npm.

author: Ahmad365Raza
text: JFrog reports the testmetest npm worm has planted hidden payloads in 42 real GitHub repos. If any machine installed testmetest or @iobandamwer packages, treat it as compromised and follow JFrog's cleanup order before revoking tokens.

author: TTT_News_
text: Web3Auth said an infrastructure vulnerability exposed private keys for some Keplr wallets created with Google or Apple login. Web3Auth paused its embedded wallet service; Web3Auth and Keplr are conducting whitehat asset recoveries. Seed-phrase and hardware wallets are not affected.

author: TomasHermannTI
text: CVE-2026-19868: SonicWall SSL VPN credentials for an alternate login method can bypass SAML-enforced MFA. CISA lists it as actively exploited.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-123158 in OpenSSH on musl-based systems is actively exploited, with confirmed root access on a honeypot. Search /var/log/messages for "Accepted password for" on accounts lacking a password hash, then patch and restart sshd.

author: diptanu
text: Tensorlake reported a security incident with no impact to customer information such as API keys or sandboxes. An application running on an upstream provider spun up sandboxes in the engineering team's accounts and ran automation workflows.

author: cloudsa
text: cPGuard's hijacked update channel (5.88.12-5.88.19) ran as root on about 2,950 hosting servers; the patch removes the backdoor, not the stolen credentials. OpenSSH on Alpine/musl (CVE-2026-123158, CVSS 8.1) lets 257-1,024-byte passwords into no-password accounts.

author: SCMagazine
text: More than 1,000 GitLab servers remain exposed to an actively exploited, critical RCE flaw. Experts warn attackers could steal credentials and compromise software supply chains.

author: PumpkinSecurity
text: A Railway engineer admitted testing AI agents on Primcloud, whose founder says they sought customer secrets and scanned its network.

author: cveintelligence
text: Critical 9.1 | CVE-2026-120984: Red Hat Keycloak – malicious JS policy upload leading to RCE. An authenticated attacker with client management permissions can run arbitrary code on the server. No patch listed yet.
